import hashlib,json,pathlib,sys,time
root=pathlib.Path('/var/projects/toy_physics/research/pde_ledger_v3')
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
from S11c_d_output_codec import decoded_lines
base=pathlib.Path('/tmp/s11cd-threshold-20260911')
old=pathlib.Path('/tmp/s11cd-exceptional-strata-20260911/bulk_full/full.out')
new=base/'full/full.out'
started=time.monotonic()
def sha(path):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with path.open('rb') as stream:
  for block in iter(lambda:stream.read(1048576),b''):h.update(block)
 return h.hexdigest()
def read(path):
 values={};duplicates=[]
 for line in decoded_lines(path):
  tag,_,payload=line.rstrip('\n').partition(': ')
  if tag in values:duplicates.append(tag)
  values[tag]=hashlib.sha256(payload.encode()).hexdigest()
 return values,duplicates
a,ad=read(old);b,bd=read(new)
changed={k:{'before':v,'after':b[k]} for k,v in a.items() if k in b and b[k]!=v}
result={'baseline':str(old),'baselineSha256':sha(old),'transcript':str(new),'sha256':sha(new),
 'baselineTagCount':len(a),'newTagCount':len(b),'unchangedPayloadCount':sum(b.get(k)==v for k,v in a.items()),
 'missingTags':sorted(set(a)-set(b)),'addedTags':sorted(set(b)-set(a)),'changedPayloads':changed,
 'baselineDuplicateTags':ad,'newDuplicateTags':bd,
 'instrumentSha256':sha(pathlib.Path(__file__)),'codecSha256':sha(root/'scripts/S11c_d_output_codec.py'),
 'wallSeconds':time.monotonic()-started}
(root/'_measurements/S11c_d_threshold_full_payload_inventory.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ('addedTags','changedPayloads')}|{'addedTagCount':len(result['addedTags']),'rawChangedCount':len(changed)}))

import pathlib,subprocess,sys,json,time,hashlib
root=pathlib.Path('/var/projects/toy_physics/research/pde_ledger_v3');base=pathlib.Path('/tmp/s11cd-threshold-20260911');full=base/'full/full.out';baseline=base.parent/'s11cd-exceptional-strata-20260911/bulk_full/full.out'
m=json.loads((base/'full/manifest.json').read_text())
if m.get('exit_code')!=0 or m['source_hashes_before']!=m['source_hashes_after']:raise RuntimeError('stable completed full producer required')
commands=[]
for kind,instrument in [('resolvent','S11c_d_end_resolvent_inventory.py'),('joint','S11c_d_joint_sheet_inventory.py'),('spectrum','S11c_d_end_spectrum_inventory.py'),('exceptional','S11c_d_exceptional_strata_inventory.py')]:
 commands.append((kind,[sys.executable,'_measurements/'+instrument,str(full),'--baseline',str(baseline),'--output',str(root/'_measurements'/('S11c_d_threshold_full_'+kind+'_inventory.json'))]))
commands.append(('threshold',[sys.executable,'_measurements/S11c_d_threshold_modes_inventory.py',str(full),'--output',str(root/'_measurements/S11c_d_threshold_full_modes_inventory.json')]))
commands.append(('payload',[sys.executable,str(base/'payload_inventory.py')]))
commands.append(('inverse',[sys.executable,'_measurements/S11c_d_inverse_fourier_inventory.py',str(full)]))
commands.append(('expand',[sys.executable,'scripts/S11c_d_output_codec.py',str(full),str(base/'full/expanded.out')]))
commands.append(('codec',[sys.executable,'_measurements/S11c_d_output_codec_check.py',str(base/'full/expanded.out'),'--output',str(root/'_measurements/S11c_d_threshold_full_codec_inventory.json')]))
records=[]
for name,command in commands:
 start=time.monotonic();out=base/'full'/('inventory_'+name+'.stdout');err=base/'full'/('inventory_'+name+'.stderr')
 with out.open('xb') as stdout,err.open('xb') as stderr:
  result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr)
 record={'kind':name,'command':command,'exitCode':result.returncode,'wallSeconds':time.monotonic()-start,'stderrBytes':err.stat().st_size,'stdoutBytes':out.stat().st_size}
 records.append(record)
 (base/'full/inventory_runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
 if result.returncode:raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
 if name=='inverse':
  value=json.loads(out.read_text());(root/'_measurements/S11c_d_threshold_full_inverse_inventory.json').write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n')

command=[sys.executable,'_measurements/S11c_d_payload_preservation_inventory.py','_measurements/S11c_d_threshold_full_payload_inventory.json','_measurements/S11c_d_threshold_full_exceptional_inventory.json','--output','_measurements/S11c_d_threshold_full_payload_preservation.json']
start=time.monotonic()
outpath=base/'full/inventory_preservation.stdout';errpath=base/'full/inventory_preservation.stderr'
with outpath.open('x') as out,errpath.open('x') as err:
 result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,stdout=out,stderr=err)
record={'kind':'preservation','command':command,'exitCode':result.returncode,'wallSeconds':time.monotonic()-start,'stderrBytes':errpath.stat().st_size,'stdoutBytes':outpath.stat().st_size}
records.append(record)
(base/'full/inventory_runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
if result.returncode:raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
